title: Freya and the Drop
author: Astrid Nakamura
blurb: Ulyana Sandoval, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
